preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**4 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the sequence N is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= B[i] <= i+1 for i in range(N)) for N, B in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element B[i] in the sequence is between 1 and i+1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, B in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(T)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if all(all(B[i] == 1 or B[i] == B[j] for j in range(i+1, N) if B[j] != 1) for i in range(N)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if for each element B[i] in the sequence, either B[i] is 1 or B[i] is equal to some other element B[j] (where j > i) that is not 1; otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
